Process_Text.original: Castings in the form of tapered rods prepared at Doncasters Precision Castings Ltd., using casting stock melted by Ross & Catherall. Ceramic moulds de-waxed in steam furnace for 5 min, sintered at 1000 °C for 1 h. Casting under vacuum, mould temperature ~1000 °C. HIP at 1195 °C for 5 h under 175 MPa. Primary ageing at 1120 °C for 4 h, air-cooling. Secondary ageing at 845 °C for 24 h, air-cooling.
Process_Text.simplified: Vacuum investment casting → HIP (1195 °C, 5 h, 175 MPa) → Primary ageing (1120 °C, 4 h, AC) → Secondary ageing (845 °C, 24 h, AC)

Equipment.Name: Doncasters Precision Castings Ltd. casting facility

Processing.Note: Same heat treatment conditions applied to all four alloys; process parameters shared per explicit statement in paper.

Structure_Text.original: In the boron-free alloy, particles along grain boundaries correspond to M₂₃C₆-type carbides. Combined SEM and TEM confirmed inter- and intragranular MC carbides. Cr-rich M₂₃C₆ carbides at grain boundaries. Nano-sized M₂₃C₆ carbides coherent with γ matrix observed near grain boundaries, plate-shaped, up to 200 nm in length and 30 nm in thickness. Continuous γ' layers not observed along grain boundaries.
Structure_Text.simplified: γ matrix + γ' precipitates + Cr-rich M₂₃C₆ carbides (intergranular) + Ta-rich MC carbides (inter- and intragranular). No grain boundary borides. No excessive γ' layers at GBs.

Structure_Text.original: In boron-containing alloys, particles along grain boundaries have tetragonal structure corresponding to M₅B₃-type boride. No intergranular M₂₃C₆ carbides found. Nano-sized M₂₃C₆ carbides observed near grain boundaries. Borides mainly enriched in chromium. γ' layers at grain boundaries near MC carbides.
Structure_Text.simplified: γ matrix + γ' precipitates + Cr-rich M₅B₃ borides (intergranular) + Ta-rich MC carbides (inter- and intragranular) + nano-sized M₂₃C₆ near GB. Grain boundaries decorated mostly by borides with large discrete γ' particles in vicinity.

Structure_Text.original: Grain boundary region contains M₅B₃ borides. Higher volume fraction of borides than LB and MB. When MC carbides dominate along boundaries, grain boundary γ' particles form nearly continuous layers. Nano-sized M₂₃C₆ near grain boundaries.
